shapeSummary: L-shaped 90° aluminum angle bracket, 32x32x32 mm bounds, 8 mm thick legs: a horizontal base plate (Y 0..8) and a vertical plate (Z -16..-8, Y 0..32), with outer corners chamfered 4 mm. Each leg has a 14 mm central through-bore with 8 M4 clearance holes (4.2 mm) around it: 4 cardinal holes at 10 mm radius and 4 diagonal holes at (±7, ±7).
warnings: No dimensions were provided; all sizes are estimates on the goBILDA 8 mm grid, so leg thickness, 32 mm bounds, bore size and hole positions are unverified.
Counterbores and nut pockets on the diagonal holes are visible in the image but omitted because their size and depth are uncertain and they would overlap the central bore.
All 8 holes per leg are modeled as plain 4.2 mm through-holes.
Chamfer size (4 mm) is estimated, and the inside-corner edge is left sharp.
Pattern centers are offset from the leg centers to clear the inside corner (Z=4 on the base, Y=20 on the vertical leg).

def pattern(cx,cy):

    small=[(cx+10,cy),(cx-10,cy),(cx,cy+10),(cx,cy-10),(cx+7,cy+7),(cx-7,cy+7),(cx+7,cy-7),(cx-7,cy-7)]
    return big,small
